verdict.rationale: Browser Use documents saved profiles that persist cookies and login state, so you log in once and reuse the session without re-entering credentials. Its 2FA guide relies on a human checkpoint instead: the run stops at the 2FA screen and a user enters the code via the live view. The guide also says saved profiles or human checkpoints are 'the most reliable options', which implies no autonomous TOTP handling. Missing for 10: a credential vault or secret store, automated TOTP/2FA code generation by the agent, documented masking of secrets from the model, and independent corroboration.
